patches_added.name: Keep the next videos in full screen
patches_added.description: From most pages, TikTok's full screen view opens with only the video you were on, so there's nothing to swipe to and it can't move on by itself. This brings the videos after it along. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Hide already seen videos
patches_modified.description: Remembers the videos you've watched and hides them when the feed sends them again, so you only see new ones. It can also keep a watch history you can search and reopen videos from. Both stay on your phone. Starts off. Turn them on in Hushfeed settings > Feed filter.
patches_modified.previous_description: Remembers the videos you've watched and hides them when the feed sends them again, so you only see new ones. The list stays on your phone. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Feed filter.

patches_added.name: Block author button
patches_added.description: Adds a button on videos to block the creator in one tap, with undo. Also adds the pause switches (comments, returning to the app, first video, keep paused). Starts off. Turn it on in Erudite settings > Hushfeed features.

patches_added.name: Comment tools
patches_added.description: Hides comments with words you pick or from accounts you pick, and adds a search box for a video's comments. It can also make links tappable and show poll results before you vote. Starts off. Turn it on in Erudite settings > Hushfeed features.

patches_added.name: Copy bio and IDs
patches_added.description: Lets you long-press a bio to copy it and adds share sheet buttons that copy a display name, username, user ID or video ID. On a profile card inside a LIVE room, long-press the bio or the name to copy it, long-press the username for the user ID, or tap the copy mark by the username. On by default. Turn it off in Erudite settings > Hushfeed features.

patches_added.name: Double-tap controls
patches_added.description: Lets a double tap on a video do nothing, like or unlike it, open its comments, copy the video or sound link, find the sound on YouTube Music or open search, instead of only liking it. Each corner of the video can get its own action too. Starts off. Pick an action in Erudite settings > Hushfeed features.

patches_added.name: Expand activity list
patches_added.description: Shows the whole Activity and New followers lists in the Inbox, so you don't have to tap View all. Starts off. Turn it on in Erudite settings > Hushfeed features.

patches_added.name: Favorite playlists search V1
patches_added.description: Adds an option to show a search bar on the favorite playlists page that instantly filters your playlists by name, loading the remaining pages in the background while you search.

patches_added.name: Favorites rate limit retry
patches_added.description: Adds an option to queue favorites TikTok refuses with "You're adding to Favorites too fast" and save them automatically once TikTok allows it, also after the app is restarted.

patches_added.name: Keep the Favorites tab
patches_added.description: Keeps the Favorites tab and your saved videos on your profile when TikTok tries out a version of the app that hides them, and makes the collections popup you get by holding the Favorites button dark when TikTok is. Both are on by default. Turn them off in Erudite settings > Hushfeed features.

patches_added.name: Liked videos search V1
patches_added.description: Adds an option to show a search bar on the liked videos page that instantly filters your liked videos by description or creator, loading the remaining pages in the background while you search.

patches_added.name: Liked videos search V2
patches_added.description: Liked videos search V1 plus an experimental server search: each query also asks TikTok's server for matching liked videos, so videos that have not loaded yet show up right away. Falls back to V1 when the server does not return your liked videos.

patches_added.name: Not interested button
patches_added.description: Adds a button on videos that tells TikTok you're not interested in one tap, so it can show you fewer like it. Starts off. Turn it on in Erudite settings > Hushfeed features.

patches_added.name: Show exact counts
patches_added.description: Shows likes, comments and other counts as full numbers, like 1,234,567 instead of 1.2M. Starts off. Turn it on in Erudite settings > Hushfeed features.

patches_removed.name: Favorite playlists search
patches_removed.description: Adds an option to show a search bar on the favorite playlists page that filters loaded playlists by name.

patches_removed.name: Liked videos search
patches_removed.description: Adds an option to show a search bar on the liked videos page that filters loaded videos by description or creator.

patches_modified.name: Always show publish date
patches_modified.description: Always shows the publish date in video author information. Thanks to lyyako for the original implementation.

patches_modified.name: Collection picker search
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to show a search bar on the sheet where you pick the collection for a saved video, so you do not have to scroll through every collection.

patches_modified.name: Collection videos search
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to show a search bar inside a collection that filters loaded videos by description or creator.

patches_modified.name: Comment sort controls
patches_modified.description: Exposes TikTok's native full comment-sort sheet, including its hot, time, media, and creator modes, instead of relying on rollout gates.

patches_modified.name: Copy comments without username
patches_modified.description: Copies only the comment text without including the creator's username.

patches_modified.name: Custom offline videos limit
patches_modified.description: Adds a custom entry to TikTok's offline videos menu with a configurable limit from 1 to 1000 videos.

patches_modified.name: Diagnostic tools
patches_modified.description: Adds diagnostic logging, crash capture, reports, and an optional rolling feed debugger.

patches_modified.name: Disable login requirement
patches_modified.description: Removes TikTok's mandatory login gate from supported flows.

patches_modified.name: Disable long-press quick share
patches_modified.description: Keeps long-pressing Share from opening TikTok's quick-share interaction.

patches_modified.name: Disable long-press repost
patches_modified.description: Keeps holding Like from opening TikTok's repost action.

patches_modified.name: Disable screen capture detection
patches_modified.description: Disables capture detection and secure-window screenshot protection, including Circle to Search blocking.

patches_modified.name: Downloads
patches_modified.description: Adds watermark-free downloads, video quality selection, comment sticker saving, configurable folders, and filename templates.

patches_modified.name: Enable Live search
patches_modified.description: Shows TikTok's search entry in the Live drawer where supported.

patches_modified.name: Enable non-personalized search
patches_modified.description: Uses TikTok's non-personalized search mode instead of its saved account choice.

patches_modified.name: Enable voice comments
patches_modified.description: Enables TikTok's native voice-comment recording and publishing entry points.

patches_modified.name: Favorite playlists grid
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to show favorite playlists in a 3-column 8pt grid with square covers and the title and video count below.

patches_modified.name: Feature Gate Lab
patches_modified.description: Adds a menu for viewing and overriding supported TikTok feature flags and configuration values.

patches_modified.name: Feed filter
patches_modified.description: Hides feed ads, TikTok Shop items, livestreams, stories, photo posts, and videos outside configured view or like ranges.

patches_modified.name: Feed tab navigation
patches_modified.description: Controls which loaded top and bottom navigation tabs remain visible, blocks newly added tabs when requested, and can hide the Tako AI bubble.

patches_modified.name: Fix Google login
patches_modified.description: Restores Google account sign-in after patching.

patches_modified.name: Foldable split comment view
patches_modified.description: Forces TikTok's tablet-style split layout (video beside comments instead of a bottom sheet) once the screen is at least as wide as a configurable threshold, for foldables TikTok doesn't already recognize as tablet-class.

patches_modified.name: Force show Auto scroll
patches_modified.description: Adds a setting that bypasses TikTok's rollout gates for its native Auto scroll action on supported videos.

patches_modified.name: Hide AI content
patches_modified.description: Hides posts marked as AI-generated or AI-modified by TikTok or their creators. Unmarked AI content may still appear.

patches_modified.name: Hide CAPTCHA popups
patches_modified.description: Adds a default-off setting to hide browsing and LIVE puzzle dialogs while preserving login and account verification.

patches_modified.name: Hide FYP unpersonalized slop videos
patches_modified.description: Hides certain batches of unpersonalized slop posts that appear in your For You feed.

patches_modified.name: Hide feed LIVE button
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to hide the LIVE button at the top left of video feeds.

patches_modified.name: Hide feed follow button
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to hide the + follow button below creator avatars in video feeds.

patches_modified.name: Hide feed save button
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to hide the save/favourites button from video feeds.

patches_modified.name: Hide feed search button
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to hide the search button at the top right of video feeds.

patches_modified.name: Hide floating promotions
patches_modified.description: Removes floating promotional badges, coin icons, and timer banners from the Home feed.

patches_modified.name: Hide quick comment reactions
patches_modified.description: Hides TikTok's exposed quick emoji row in supported comment inputs.

patches_modified.name: Hide suggested accounts
patches_modified.description: Removes suggested-account cards from profile and inbox surfaces. Thanks to tymmesyde for the original implementation.

patches_modified.name: Hold-and-slide 2x lock
patches_modified.description: Enables TikTok's native hold, slide down, and release gesture to lock 2x speed.

patches_modified.name: Inbox activity search
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to show a search bar on the Activity notifications and New followers pages to filter by user, comment, or notification text.

patches_modified.name: Keep collections loaded
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to remember every collection you have loaded, so the collections page and the save sheet show them all right away instead of loading them page by page again.

patches_modified.name: Open external links directly
patches_modified.description: Opens profile and story website links in the system browser instead of TikTok's in-app browser. Thanks to lyyako for the original implementation.

patches_modified.name: Playback speed
patches_modified.description: Enables playback-speed controls for all videos and remembers the selected speed between videos.

patches_modified.name: Region spoof
patches_modified.description: Adds in-app controls for changing the region TikTok reads.

patches_modified.name: Remember clear display
patches_modified.description: Remembers TikTok's clear-display state between videos.

patches_modified.name: Resume videos after scrolling
patches_modified.description: Continues supported videos from where playback stopped when returning after a scroll.

patches_modified.name: Sanitize sharing links
patches_modified.description: Removes tracking parameters from TikTok links before they are shared.

patches_modified.name: Settings
patches_modified.description: Adds the Crazy Erudite Patches settings menu to TikTok. Supports TikTok 47.6.3, 47.4.3 and 47.2.41.

patches_modified.description: Keeps holding Like from opening TikTok's repost action.

patches_modified.name: Disable screen capture detection
patches_modified.description: Disables capture detection and secure-window screenshot protection, including Circle to Search blocking.

patches_modified.name: Downloads
patches_modified.description: Adds watermark-free downloads, video quality selection, comment sticker saving, configurable folders, and filename templates.

patches_modified.name: Enable Live search
patches_modified.description: Shows TikTok's search entry in the Live drawer where supported.

patches_modified.name: Enable non-personalized search
patches_modified.description: Uses TikTok's non-personalized search mode instead of its saved account choice.

patches_modified.name: Enable voice comments
patches_modified.description: Enables TikTok's native voice-comment recording and publishing entry points.

patches_modified.name: Favorite playlists grid
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to show favorite playlists in a 3-column 8pt grid with square covers and the title and video count below.

patches_modified.name: Feature Gate Lab
patches_modified.description: Adds a menu for viewing and overriding supported TikTok feature flags and configuration values.

patches_modified.name: Feed filter
patches_modified.description: Hides feed ads, TikTok Shop items, livestreams, stories, photo posts, and videos outside configured view or like ranges.

patches_modified.name: Feed tab navigation
patches_modified.description: Controls which loaded top and bottom navigation tabs remain visible, blocks newly added tabs when requested, and can hide the Tako AI bubble.

patches_modified.name: Fix Google login
patches_modified.description: Restores Google account sign-in after patching.

patches_modified.name: Foldable split comment view
patches_modified.description: Forces TikTok's tablet-style split layout (video beside comments instead of a bottom sheet) once the screen is at least as wide as a configurable threshold, for foldables TikTok doesn't already recognize as tablet-class.

patches_modified.name: Force show Auto scroll
patches_modified.description: Adds a setting that bypasses TikTok's rollout gates for its native Auto scroll action on supported videos.

patches_modified.name: Hide AI content
patches_modified.description: Hides posts marked as AI-generated or AI-modified by TikTok or their creators. Unmarked AI content may still appear.

patches_modified.name: Hide CAPTCHA popups
patches_modified.description: Adds a default-off setting to hide browsing and LIVE puzzle dialogs while preserving login and account verification.

patches_modified.name: Hide FYP unpersonalized slop videos
patches_modified.description: Hides certain batches of unpersonalized slop posts that appear in your For You feed.

patches_modified.name: Hide feed LIVE button
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to hide the LIVE button at the top left of video feeds.

patches_modified.name: Hide feed follow button
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to hide the + follow button below creator avatars in video feeds.

patches_modified.name: Hide feed save button
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to hide the save/favourites button from video feeds.

patches_modified.name: Hide feed search button
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to hide the search button at the top right of video feeds.

patches_modified.name: Hide floating promotions
patches_modified.description: Removes floating promotional badges, coin icons, and timer banners from the Home feed.

patches_modified.name: Hide quick comment reactions
patches_modified.description: Hides TikTok's exposed quick emoji row in supported comment inputs.

patches_modified.name: Hide suggested accounts
patches_modified.description: Removes suggested-account cards from profile and inbox surfaces. Thanks to tymmesyde for the original implementation.

patches_modified.name: Hold-and-slide 2x lock
patches_modified.description: Enables TikTok's native hold, slide down, and release gesture to lock 2x speed.

patches_modified.name: Inbox activity search
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to show a search bar on the Activity notifications and New followers pages to filter by user, comment, or notification text.

patches_modified.name: Keep collections loaded
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to remember every collection you have loaded, so the collections page and the save sheet show them all right away instead of loading them page by page again.

patches_modified.name: Open external links directly
patches_modified.description: Opens profile and story website links in the system browser instead of TikTok's in-app browser. Thanks to lyyako for the original implementation.

patches_modified.name: Playback speed
patches_modified.description: Enables playback-speed controls for all videos and remembers the selected speed between videos.

patches_modified.name: Region spoof
patches_modified.description: Adds in-app controls for changing the region TikTok reads.

patches_modified.name: Remember clear display
patches_modified.description: Remembers TikTok's clear-display state between videos.

patches_modified.name: Resume videos after scrolling
patches_modified.description: Continues supported videos from where playback stopped when returning after a scroll.

patches_modified.name: Sanitize sharing links
patches_modified.description: Removes tracking parameters from TikTok links before they are shared.

patches_modified.name: Settings
patches_modified.description: Adds the Crazy Erudite Patches settings menu to TikTok. Supports TikTok 47.6.3, 47.4.3 and 47.2.41.
patches_modified.previous_description: Adds the Crazy Erudite Patches settings menu to TikTok. Supports TikTok 47.4.3 and 47.2.41.

patches_modified.name: Share sheet modification
patches_modified.description: Adds toggles and allow-lists for the video share sheet's "Send to", "Share via app", and "Video Actions" sections.

patches_modified.name: Show seekbar
patches_modified.description: Shows TikTok's native video seekbar where it would normally be hidden.

patches_modified.name: Show seekbar thumbnail
patches_modified.description: Shows TikTok's video preview thumbnail while dragging the seekbar.

patches_modified.name: Sort collections
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to sort collections by recent activity (normal), by video count (most first) or by reverse video count (fewest first).

patches_modified.name: Stop video looping
patches_modified.description: Stops videos at the end instead of replaying them.

patches_modified.name: Translate comments
patches_modified.description: Adds comment translation controls using TikTok's translation system, with selectable language exclusions.

patches_modified.name: Remove ads, proxy & restrictions
patches_modified.description: Stops background bandwidth sharing and removes ads, sponsor popups, and forced updates.
patches_modified.previous_description: Removes CashRaven background bandwidth sharing, all ads and sponsor/unlock gates, external browser redirects, the startup Telegram join dialog, promo marquee banners, forced-update lockouts, and promo push notifications. Optional clone/sniffer-check bypass and native-library stripping are off by default.

patches_modified.name: Remove ads, telemetry & restrictions
patches_modified.description: Removes ads, tracking, and forced updates, and keeps channels working after patching.
patches_modified.previous_description: Replaces native signature-locked config decryption in pure Java so encrypted channel and event feeds keep loading after Morphe re-signs the APK, removes all banner/start/support/external ads, optionally disables the in-app web view, suppresses update lockouts, and optionally bypasses root/sniffer/proxy-cert checks. Strips Firebase telemetry and push notifications.

patches_modified.name: Clean Me page
patches_modified.description: Removes Status Saver, Legal, and Help from the Me page.
patches_modified.previous_description: Removes the Status Saver, Legal, and Help sections from the Me page while keeping the 8-item local tools grid, App Theme, Settings, and Custom Pop-up Play.

patches_modified.name: Custom codec
patches_modified.description: Bundles a custom codec so AC-3, E-AC-3, DTS, and TrueHD audio play out of the box.
patches_modified.previous_description: Bundles an MX Player v3.1.0 custom codec (aio-v3.1.0_r1.zip, architecture ZIP, or libffmpeg.mx.so*) directly into the app for out-of-the-box E-AC-3, TrueHD, MLP, DTS, and AC-3 software audio decoding.

patches_modified.name: Remove ads & bloat
patches_modified.description: Removes ads and online extras like Live TV, Tube, Shorts, and Games for a clean local player.
patches_modified.previous_description: Removes banner, folder, player, interstitial, rewarded, app-open, exit, and Me-page ads, removes the Home horizontal shortcut strip and online Zodiac App Themes, and disables Live TV, mxplay OTT streaming, MX Tube, Shorts, and Games while keeping Local Music, All-Files-Access setup, and 1-tap Classic Themes working offline and online.

patches_modified.name: Remove bottom navigation bar
patches_modified.description: Removes the bottom navigation bar and moves Me to the top-right corner.
patches_modified.previous_description: Removes the bottom navigation bar from the UI and moves Me to the upper-right corner of the Home toolbar. Leave unchecked to keep the bottom navigation bar.

patches_modified.name: Remove ads, popups & restrictions
patches_modified.description: Removes ads and promo popups, and keeps channels working after patching.
patches_modified.previous_description: Replaces the native signature-locked decryption in pure Java so encrypted channel and event feeds keep loading after Morphe re-signs the APK, and removes start/player/support/external ads plus the automatic Telegram promo dialog.

patches_modified.name: Remove ads, telemetry & restrictions
patches_modified.description: Removes ads, promo popups, and tracking, and keeps channels working after patching.
patches_modified.previous_description: Replaces native signature-locked config decryption in pure Java, removes all banner/popunder/timer ads and the local NanoHTTPD ad server, suppresses the startup Telegram popup and player watermarks, strips Firebase telemetry and push notifications, and bypasses update lockouts. Optional root/sniffer bypass and native/telemetry stripping are off by default.

patches_modified.name: AdBlocker turbo & userscript bundle
patches_modified.description: Updates the built-in ad blocker automatically in seconds instead of minutes, and can add a shortlink bypass userscript.
patches_modified.previous_description: Syncs SHA-256-verified pre-compiled AdBlocker binary engines + per-list filter archives (28 default lists, ~1.22M active rules) automatically in the background with instant Hosts & filters hydration, accelerates on-device filter compilation via 64 KB write buffering + foreground thread scheduling, and optionally seeds and auto-updates the mobile-adapted Bypass All Shortlinks userscript.

patches_modified.name: Browser setup prompts only once
patches_modified.description: Shows the one-time browser setup prompts only once, even if you close the browser early.
patches_modified.previous_description: Shows the default-browser, accessibility, shortcut-menu-strip, and adblocker setup prompts once, recording each as shown as soon as it appears so closing the browser before dismissing cannot make it repeat.

patches_modified.name: Optimize cold start and battery
patches_modified.description: Makes the app open faster, use less battery in the background, and stay in Recents when you press Back.
patches_modified.previous_description: Eliminates cold-start Chromium WebView initialization in Download Manager and background services, defers Browser AdBlock filter parsing until Browser launch, defers the CheckAppVersion subprocess past startup, pauses MainActivity's 1 Hz background wakeup loop when minimized, and keeps 1DM alive in Android Recents on Back press without killing background downloads.

patches_modified.name: Preset browser settings
patches_modified.description: Sets Brave as the default search engine on fresh installs. You can change it anytime in 1DM.
patches_modified.previous_description: Sets fresh-install browser fallbacks for normal and incognito modes: Brave search, matching suggestions, and Google search by image by default. Saved or imported choices are preserved and can be changed later in 1DM.

patches_modified.description: Removes banner and popup ads, upgrade offers, and sponsored shortcuts.
patches_modified.previous_description: Removes banner, interstitial, fallback, and Amazon ads, 1DM+ sale/VPN/drawer/rate promotions, sponsored browser tiles, promo FCM topics, and 17 ad/telemetry SDK initializers and native/asset payloads from free 1DM 20.0 (30257).

patches_modified.name: Block background-return feed refresh
patches_modified.description: Keeps your place in your feed when you leave Threads and come back within ten minutes. Pulling down to refresh still loads new posts. Good if you hate losing the post you were reading. Starts off. Turn it on in HushThreads settings > Feed.

patches_modified.name: Change version code
patches_modified.description: Raises the version number as high as Android allows, so Google Play won't offer Meta's updates over it. Going back to stock Threads means uninstalling, which deletes its data. It isn't selected by default. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_modified.name: Disable analytics
patches_modified.description: Stops Threads from sending most of its usage reports to Meta. A few may still get through. Good if you'd rather share less about how you use the app. On by default. Turn it off in HushThreads settings > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: Disable screenshot detection
patches_modified.description: Threads isn't told when you take a screenshot. It stops watching your photos for new screenshots. Good if you want to screenshot without Threads noticing. Starts off. Turn it on in HushThreads settings > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: Disable swipe to Search
patches_modified.description: Stops a sideways swipe on your feed from sliding into Search. The Search button still opens Search. Threads only has the swipe on some accounts. Good if you keep landing in Search while you scroll. Starts off. Turn it on in HushThreads settings > Feed.

patches_modified.name: Disable video autoplay
patches_modified.description: Videos in your feed wait for a tap instead of playing as you scroll. Good for a calmer feed and less data use. Starts off. Turn it on in HushThreads settings > Feed.

patches_modified.name: Hide ads
patches_modified.description: Removes sponsored posts from your feed and from under the posts you open before Threads shows them, so they leave no gap. On by default. Turn it off in HushThreads settings > Feed.

patches_modified.name: Hide ghost post bubbles
patches_modified.description: Takes the ghost post bubbles off profile pictures, on profiles and in the row at the top of your feed. The pictures and the ghost posts themselves stay. Good for a calmer look. Starts off. Turn it on in HushThreads settings > Appearance.

patches_modified.name: Hide suggested users
patches_modified.description: Removes the cards that suggest accounts to follow, in your feed and on profiles, and the Follow suggestions row in Search. Normal posts and reposts stay, and so does the rest of a profile or Search. Good if you only want posts in your feed. On by default. Its two switches are in HushThreads settings > Feed.

patches_modified.name: Hide the Instagram button
patches_modified.description: Takes the Instagram button off the top of profiles, yours and other people's. The other buttons stay. Good for a tidier profile. Starts off. Turn it on in HushThreads settings > Appearance.

patches_modified.name: HushThreads settings
patches_modified.description: Adds a HushThreads page to Threads where you turn features on or off, pause HushThreads, back up your settings and read the licenses. Open it from Threads' own settings, or long-press the Threads logo at the top of your feed. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_modified.name: Max image quality
patches_modified.description: Loads photos at the largest size Threads has, instead of one picked for your screen. Photos look sharper but use more data. Starts off. Turn it on in HushThreads settings > Feed.

patches_modified.name: Open links in browser
patches_modified.description: Opens links you tap in your regular browser instead of inside Threads, and skips Threads' link tracking. Threads, Instagram and other Meta pages still open in Threads. On by default. Turn it off in HushThreads settings > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: Pure black dark mode
patches_modified.description: Makes Threads' dark mode truly black instead of dark gray behind your feed and posts. It looks deeper and can save battery on OLED screens. Starts off. Turn it on in HushThreads settings > Appearance.

patches_modified.name: Remove share targets
patches_modified.description: Takes Threads out of the share menu in other apps, so it isn't offered when you share a link, photo or video. Sharing from Threads still works. It isn't selected by default. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_modified.name: Remove the advertising ID
patches_modified.description: Stops Threads from reading your phone's advertising ID. It gets a string of zeros instead. Good for making your phone harder to track across apps. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_modified.name: Restore screens on re-signed builds
patches_modified.description: Fixes Threads screens that fail on a patched app because they check who signed it. Also lets Threads share sign-in with an Instagram signed with this build's key, and makes the share sheet's tiles open patched Meta apps. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_modified.name: Sanitize sharing links
patches_modified.description: Removes tracking tags from links you copy or share from Threads, and turns short share links into the post's own link. The link still opens the same post. On by default. Turn it off in HushThreads settings > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: Save photos and videos
patches_modified.description: Adds Save to a post's menu, below Copy link. It saves the photo or video to your gallery, every page of a carousel too, and on a text post it saves the video that post links or quotes. Good for keeping posts you like. On by default. Turn it off in HushThreads settings > Downloads.

patches_modified.name: Trust user-added certificates
patches_modified.description: Lets Threads accept security certificates you installed yourself, such as for a work network or a debugging proxy. Meta's own checks stay, so a proxy can't read most traffic. It isn't selected by default. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_modified.name: Block background-return feed refresh

patches_modified.description: Stops Threads from sending most of its usage reports to Meta. A few may still get through. Good if you'd rather share less about how you use the app. On by default. Turn it off in HushThreads settings > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: Disable screenshot detection
patches_modified.description: Threads isn't told when you take a screenshot. It stops watching your photos for new screenshots. Good if you want to screenshot without Threads noticing. Starts off. Turn it on in HushThreads settings > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: Disable swipe to Search
patches_modified.description: Stops a sideways swipe on your feed from sliding into Search. The Search button still opens Search. Threads only has the swipe on some accounts. Good if you keep landing in Search while you scroll. Starts off. Turn it on in HushThreads settings > Feed.

patches_modified.name: Disable video autoplay
patches_modified.description: Videos in your feed wait for a tap instead of playing as you scroll. Good for a calmer feed and less data use. Starts off. Turn it on in HushThreads settings > Feed.

patches_modified.name: Hide ads
patches_modified.description: Removes sponsored posts from your feed and from under the posts you open before Threads shows them, so they leave no gap. On by default. Turn it off in HushThreads settings > Feed.

patches_modified.name: Hide ghost post bubbles
patches_modified.description: Takes the ghost post bubbles off profile pictures, on profiles and in the row at the top of your feed. The pictures and the ghost posts themselves stay. Good for a calmer look. Starts off. Turn it on in HushThreads settings > Appearance.

patches_modified.name: Hide suggested users
patches_modified.description: Removes the cards that suggest accounts to follow, in your feed and on profiles, and the Follow suggestions row in Search. Normal posts and reposts stay, and so does the rest of a profile or Search. Good if you only want posts in your feed. On by default. Its two switches are in HushThreads settings > Feed.

patches_modified.name: Hide the Instagram button
patches_modified.description: Takes the Instagram button off the top of profiles, yours and other people's. The other buttons stay. Good for a tidier profile. Starts off. Turn it on in HushThreads settings > Appearance.

patches_modified.name: HushThreads settings
patches_modified.description: Adds a HushThreads page to Threads where you turn features on or off, pause HushThreads, back up your settings and read the licenses. Open it from Threads' own settings, or long-press the Threads logo at the top of your feed. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_modified.name: Max image quality
patches_modified.description: Loads photos at the largest size Threads has, instead of one picked for your screen. Photos look sharper but use more data. Starts off. Turn it on in HushThreads settings > Feed.

patches_modified.name: Open links in browser
patches_modified.description: Opens links you tap in your regular browser instead of inside Threads, and skips Threads' link tracking. Threads, Instagram and other Meta pages still open in Threads. On by default. Turn it off in HushThreads settings > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: Pure black dark mode
patches_modified.description: Makes Threads' dark mode truly black instead of dark gray behind your feed and posts. It looks deeper and can save battery on OLED screens. Starts off. Turn it on in HushThreads settings > Appearance.

patches_modified.name: Remove share targets
patches_modified.description: Takes Threads out of the share menu in other apps, so it isn't offered when you share a link, photo or video. Sharing from Threads still works. It isn't selected by default. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_modified.name: Remove the advertising ID
patches_modified.description: Stops Threads from reading your phone's advertising ID. It gets a string of zeros instead. Good for making your phone harder to track across apps. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_modified.name: Restore screens on re-signed builds
patches_modified.description: Fixes Threads screens that fail on a patched app because they check who signed it. Also lets Threads share sign-in with an Instagram signed with this build's key, and makes the share sheet's tiles open patched Meta apps. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_modified.name: Sanitize sharing links
patches_modified.description: Removes tracking tags from links you copy or share from Threads, and turns short share links into the post's own link. The link still opens the same post. On by default. Turn it off in HushThreads settings > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: Save photos and videos
patches_modified.description: Adds Save to a post's menu, below Copy link. It saves the photo or video to your gallery, every page of a carousel too, and on a text post it saves the video that post links or quotes. Good for keeping posts you like. On by default. Turn it off in HushThreads settings > Downloads.

patches_modified.name: Trust user-added certificates
patches_modified.description: Lets Threads accept security certificates you installed yourself, such as for a work network or a debugging proxy. Meta's own checks stay, so a proxy can't read most traffic. It isn't selected by default. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_added.name: Full-screen chat in landscape

patches_added.name: Keep media playing

patches_added.name: Leave group DMs silently

patches_added.name: Mutual group DMs

patches_added.name: Reply without pinging

patches_added.name: Show timeout duration

patches_added.name: View raw data

patches_modified.name: Complete badges automatically

patches_modified.name: Copy profile bios

patches_modified.name: Disable telemetry and touch logging

patches_modified.description: Files you send get a random name instead of the one on your phone. Based on Anonymous File Names by k1ng_op.

patches_modified.name: Bring back Tenor GIFs
patches_modified.description: Tenor GIFs show in Discord's GIF picker again, mixed with Discord's own or on their own. Inspired by BringBackTenor by Livie.

patches_modified.name: Bulk delete messages
patches_modified.description: Select multiple messages and delete them all at once, in one chat or across channels, servers and DMs.
patches_modified.previous_description: Select multiple messages in chat and delete them all at once.

patches_modified.name: Clean channel names
patches_modified.description: Removes emoji and symbols from channel names, and can show spaces instead of dashes.

patches_modified.name: Complete Quests automatically
patches_modified.description: Finishes video, Play and Activity Quests in the background. Discord may pause Quests on accounts that do this.

patches_modified.name: Complete badges automatically
patches_modified.description: Plays real PC games in the background, up to 3 at once, toward your Hours Played and Unique Games Played badges.

patches_modified.name: Copy profile bios
patches_modified.description: Hold a bio to select and copy it.

patches_modified.name: Custom branding
patches_modified.description: Installs Venus as its own app next to the normal Discord app, with the name, color and icon you pick. It starts signed out and keeps its own settings. Notifications work in both.

patches_modified.name: Custom themes
patches_modified.description: Install color themes from a link and switch between them. Works with Revenge and Vendetta themes.

patches_modified.name: Disable advertising identifiers
patches_modified.description: Stops Discord and AppsFlyer from reading your Google advertising ID. Always on once patched.

patches_modified.name: Disable analytics
patches_modified.description: Stops Discord's usage tracking and the analytics events it uploads. Always on once patched.

patches_modified.name: Disable crash reporting
patches_modified.description: Stops crash reports, screenshots and system logs from being sent to Sentry. Always on once patched.

patches_modified.name: Disable install attribution
patches_modified.description: Stops AppsFlyer from tracking how you installed the app. Some invite links that open before install may not work.

patches_modified.name: Disable telemetry and touch logging
patches_modified.description: Stops performance tracking, per-screen smoothness stats and records of what you tap. Always on once patched.

patches_modified.name: Double-tap to reply
patches_modified.description: Double-tap a message to reply, or your own to edit it. Triple-tap your own to delete it. Based on Geastures+ by kmmiio99o.

patches_modified.name: Edit servers locally
patches_modified.description: Give any server your own name and icon. Only you see them. Based on EditServers by mwittrien.

patches_modified.name: Favourite any image or video
patches_modified.description: Star any image or video to keep it in your GIF favourites.

patches_modified.name: Fix link previews
patches_modified.description: Links to X, Instagram, TikTok, Tumblr and more show the post. Links you send go through an embed service like FxTwitter, without tracking, and X and Bluesky posts can be translated. Inspired by FixEmbed by the ShiggyCord team.

patches_modified.name: Fix unknown mentions
patches_modified.description: @unknown-user mentions are looked up and show the person's name. Based on ValidUser by fshin, o.oer and kmmiio99o.

patches_modified.name: Hide blocked or ignored messages
patches_modified.description: Removes the "blocked messages" and "ignored messages" rows from chat, and can hide replies to them too. From Rain.

patches_modified.name: Hide typing indicator
patches_modified.description: Others won't see when you're typing. You still see when they are.

patches_modified.name: Icon packs
patches_modified.description: Replace Discord's icons with community icon packs or a custom icon pack link. Works with Themes+ icon packs.

patches_modified.name: Jump to first message
patches_modified.description: A button to go straight to the start of a chat, channel or thread.

patches_modified.name: Keep Bluetooth audio clear in calls
patches_modified.description: Headphones stay in music quality in calls. Your phone's mic picks up your voice.

patches_modified.name: Keep deleted messages
patches_modified.description: Deleted messages stay in chat, outlined in red, and edited messages show what they said before. Can be kept after restarting.

patches_modified.name: Listen along
patches_modified.description: Play what a friend is listening to on Spotify, from their profile. Needs Spotify Premium.

patches_modified.name: Load full-quality images
patches_modified.description: Pictures in chat and full screen load as uploaded, not as Discord's smaller, compressed copy, and profile pictures stay sharp. Based on Uncompressed Discord Images by Knewest and HighResProfileImages by Kawtious.

patches_modified.name: Material You colors
patches_modified.description: Colors Discord to match your wallpaper, in light and dark. Wallpaper colors need Android 12 or newer.

patches_modified.name: Message highlights
patches_modified.description: Pick bar width and colors for replies, mentions and deleted messages.

patches_modified.name: Pastel name colors
patches_modified.description: Names without a role color get a soft pastel one.

patches_modified.name: Read all button
patches_modified.description: A button under Direct Messages that marks servers, DMs or both as read.

patches_modified.name: Remove anything
patches_modified.description: Tap a button you never use to remove it, right where it is: turn on removal mode, then tap the red X on the voice message, attach, gift, call, video, search, Quests, Shop or Nitro buttons, the Quests banner, attach menu items, message menu rows and quick reactions, profile menu items, Settings rows and more. Bring them back any time in Venus.
patches_modified.previous_description: Tap a button you never use to remove it, right where it is: turn on removal mode, then tap the red X on the voice message, attach, gift, call, video, search, Quests, Shop or Nitro buttons, the Quests banner, attach menu items, profile menu items, Settings rows and more. Bring them back any time in Venus.

patches_modified.name: Send Nitro stickers and emojis as links
patches_modified.description: Sends Nitro emojis and stickers as links that show as the image.

patches_modified.name: Send audio as voice messages
patches_modified.description: Audio files are sent as voice messages. Android 10 or newer.

patches_modified.name: Send long messages
patches_modified.description: Type past the character limit. Long messages are sent in parts, split between lines or words. Based on SplitLargeMessages by sunnie.

patches_modified.name: Server info
patches_modified.description: Hold a server's icon to see its details, boosts and friends there. Based on ServerInfo by fshin.

patches_modified.name: Show device indicators
patches_modified.description: Desktop, mobile, web, console or VR icons next to names, colored by status.

patches_modified.name: Show file sizes when attaching
patches_modified.description: Photos and videos in the picker show their size.

patches_modified.name: Show hidden channels
patches_modified.description: Channels you can't open appear with a lock. Only their name and dates show, not messages.

patches_modified.name: Show owner and mod tags
patches_modified.description: Shows an Owner, Admin, Manager or Mod tag next to people's names in chat. Based on StaffTag by mwittrien.

patches_modified.name: Skip delete confirmation
patches_modified.description: Messages and link previews are removed right away, with no "Are you sure?". It can't be undone.

patches_modified.name: Skip pin confirmation
patches_modified.description: Pins and unpins messages without asking first. Based on NoConfirmPin by Skamt.

patches_modified.name: Tap mentions to open profiles
patches_modified.description: Tap an @mention in the message bar to see who it is. Based on ClickableMentions by mwittrien.

patches_modified.name: Translate messages
patches_modified.description: Messages in other languages show in yours. Their text is sent to Google Translate, without your account.

patches_modified.name: Unlock Discord experiments
patches_modified.description: Adds Dev Tools to Settings, to try features Discord is still testing. Only on this phone. Based on Experiments by maisy.

patches_modified.name: Unlock Nitro themes
patches_modified.description: Use Discord's gradient themes in Settings > Appearance without Nitro. Only this phone sees them.

patches_modified.name: Unlock app icons
patches_modified.description: Use any Discord app icon in Settings without Nitro.

patches_modified.name: Use your phone's emojis
patches_modified.description: In chat, reactions and the emoji picker, or from an emoji font you import.

patches_modified.name: Use your phone's font
patches_modified.description: Replaces Discord's font everywhere with your phone's or one you import. Android 9 or newer.

patches_modified.name: User activity notifications
patches_modified.description: Shows a notice when chosen friends or users change status, start typing or send a message. Based on UserNotif by cywrx and coder.gg.

patches_modified.name: User and server reviews
patches_modified.description: Read and write reviews on profiles and servers, from the community ReviewDB service (manti.vendicated.dev).

patches_modified.name: Venus button on profile bar
patches_modified.description: A shortcut to Venus settings, next to the notifications bell.

patches_modified.name: Venus settings
patches_modified.description: Adds Venus to Discord's settings, where you turn each feature on or off, in your language. Needed by every feature.

patches_modified.name: Voice channel options
patches_modified.description: Choose the volume, audio output and sounds for voice channels.

patches_modified.name: Pause invites
patches_modified.description: Hold a server's icon to pause its invites until you resume them, to stop a raid. Needs Manage Server.
patches_modified.previous_description: Hold a server's icon to pause or resume its invites for a while, to stop a raid. Needs Manage Server.

patches_added.name: [General] Andrew's Patch Setting
patches_added.description: Adds "Andrew's Patch Setting" to the top of the Facebook menu. There you can turn some patches on or off without patching again, and see the credits and licenses.

patches_modified.name: [Ad] Hide ad views
patches_modified.description: Hides LINE display ads: the LINE Ads banners, the Smart Channel banner in the chat list and Google AdManager ads.

patches_modified.name: [Ad] Remove banner ads
patches_modified.description: LINE no longer loads the Smart Channel banner ads. This patch makes the getBanners and getPrefetchableBanners responses null.

patches_modified.name: [Chat] Hide AI Friends button
patches_modified.description: Removes the AI Friends button from the Chats tab header. The Album button shows in its place.

patches_modified.name: [Chat] Hide Events button
patches_modified.description: Removes the "Events" row from the slide-out menu in a chat room. Events is a different feature from LINE Calendar, and it opens a server-hosted page.

patches_modified.name: [Chat] Hide LINE GIFT button
patches_modified.description: Removes the LINE GIFT tile from the + attach menu in a chat room.

patches_modified.name: [Chat] Hide Transfer button
patches_modified.description: Removes the Transfer (LINE Pay) tile from the + attach menu in a chat room.

patches_modified.name: [Chat] Hide attach menu extra tools
patches_modified.description: Removes the server-provided tools (Poll, Schedule and more) from the + menu in a chat. Built-in tiles stay.

patches_modified.name: [Chat] Hide calendar buttons
patches_modified.description: Removes every LINE Calendar button: in the Chats tab, the chat toolbar and menus, and the Home tab.

patches_modified.name: [Chat] Hide community button
patches_modified.description: Removes the community (OpenChat) button from the top of the Chats tab header.

patches_modified.name: [Chat] Hide tips under messages
patches_modified.description: Hides the "CHECK" tips under some messages, such as a received video.

patches_modified.name: [Chat] Keep chats unread
patches_modified.description: When you open a chat, LINE does not mark it read or send a read receipt. "Mark as read" still works.

patches_modified.name: [Chat] Keep unsent messages
patches_modified.description: Keeps messages that others unsend in 1:1 and group chats, with a red "Unsent" label next to the time. OpenChat is not covered.

patches_modified.name: [Fix] Restore biometric login
patches_modified.description: Biometric login can be linked again on a re-signed build. A Root Mount install does not need this patch.

patches_modified.name: [Fix] Restore chat backup sign-in via MicroG-RE
patches_modified.description: Makes Google Drive chat backup and restore work on a re-signed build, through MicroG-RE. Root Mount does not need it.

patches_modified.name: [Fix] Restore location maps via MicroG-RE
patches_modified.description: Shows maps again on a re-signed build, with OpenFreeMap tiles. It needs MicroG-RE 7.0.0 or later. Root Mount does not need it.

patches_modified.name: [Fix] Restore push notifications
patches_modified.description: When LINE is fully closed, push notifications work again on a re-signed build. LINE also gets its Firebase Remote Config again. A Root Mount install does not need this patch.

patches_modified.name: [General] Andrew's Patch Setting
patches_modified.description: Adds "Andrew's Patch Setting" to LINE Settings, below "Profile". There you can turn some patches on or off without patching again, and see the credits and licenses.

patches_modified.name: [General] Custom font
patches_modified.description: Adds a button to LINE's Font page to use a font file from your device. The page then no longer loads LINE's font list from the server.

patches_modified.name: [General] Disable VOOM
patches_modified.description: VOOM deep links, shares, and notifications do nothing. If you open the standalone VOOM feed, it closes. Messaging and the other tabs do not change.

patches_modified.name: [General] Hide Agent i buttons
patches_modified.description: Removes the Agent i button from the Home header and from the search bar, and hides Agent i in chats permanently.
patches_modified.previous_description: Removes the Agent i button from the Home header and from the search bar.

patches_modified.name: [General] Hide new item badges
patches_modified.description: Hides the green dots and N badges that mark new items, on header buttons, tabs, menus, lists and settings rows. Unread message counts do not change.

patches_modified.name: [General] Open links in external browser
patches_modified.description: Opens web links in your default browser instead of LINE's in-app browser. LIFF mini-apps and LINE links stay in LINE.

patches_modified.name: [General] Redirect LINE Pay
patches_modified.description: Opens LINE Pay in the standalone LINE Pay app, so the integrity check that fails on a re-signed build never runs.

patches_modified.name: [General] Trust user-installed CAs
patches_modified.description: Makes LINE trust certificate authorities you install, so your own HTTPS proxy can read LIFF and mini-app web traffic. Bank and LINE Pay stay pinned. For debugging. Off by default.

patches_modified.name: [Home] Hide Home content feed
patches_modified.description: Removes the content feed below the friends list on the Home tab: LINE NEWS, official account posts and rankings.

patches_modified.name: [Home] Hide Home modules
patches_modified.description: Hides the recommended content, hot-topics and ad modules on the Home tab.

patches_modified.name: [Premium] Disable LINE Premium
patches_modified.description: Hides all LINE Premium upsells, badges and pages. It unlocks nothing, because the server enforces Premium.

patches_modified.name: [Premium] Hide premium unsend upsells
patches_modified.description: Removes the Premium unsend upsells that "Disable LINE Premium" leaves. Ordinary unsend still works.

patches_modified.name: [Tab] Hide LINE TODAY tab
patches_modified.description: Removes the LINE TODAY (News) tab from the main bottom navigation, in both the news-tab and news-row layouts.

patches_modified.name: [Tab] Hide Shopping tab
patches_modified.description: Removes the Shopping tab from the main bottom navigation. This includes the Japan variant (Shopping, ショッピング) and the Taiwan variant (Discover, 逛逛).

patches_modified.name: [Tab] Hide VOOM tab
patches_modified.description: Removes the VOOM (formerly Timeline) tab from the main bottom navigation.

patches_modified.name: [Tab] Hide Wallet tab
patches_modified.description: Removes the Wallet (LINE Pay) tab from the main bottom navigation, in both the normal and mini-tab layouts.

patches_modified.previous_description: Adds a photo/video switch and saves LUT-rendered camera frames to Gallery at preview-output resolution.

patches_modified.name: Blackmagic Camera — Take Photos While Recording
patches_modified.description: Adds a shutter during active recording that copies the displayed preview without reconfiguring the camera session.
patches_modified.previous_description: Adds a recording shutter that saves a separate LUT-rendered preview frame without changing the active recording session.

patches_modified.name: Hide closeup buttons
patches_modified.description: Lets you hide the buttons on a pin you open, each with its own switch. That covers the back arrow and the visual search (lens) button that float over the picture, the like, comment, share and more buttons under it, the Remix button and the Visit site button. Another switch keeps the lens but drops its glow and the Search image label Pinterest puts on it for your first pins each day. Two more rows draw the red Save button smaller or paint it a color you pick. Your phone's back gesture still leaves the pin, and Search image in the pin menu still works. They all start off. Turn them on in HushPinterest settings > Interface.
patches_modified.previous_description: Lets you hide the back arrow and the visual search (lens) button that float over a pin you open, each with its own switch, so they stop covering the picture. A third switch keeps the lens but drops the Search image label Pinterest puts on it for your first pins each day. Your phone's back gesture still leaves the pin, and Search image in the pin menu still works. All three start off. Turn them on in HushPinterest settings > Interface.

patches_added.name: Don't report Blend visits
patches_added.description: Stops Instagram from telling a chat that you opened its Blend. Ghost mode, at the top of Ads and privacy, turns it on with the others. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Messages.

patches_added.name: Hide activity bubbles
patches_added.description: Takes the little round pictures off posts and reels that show a friend liked, commented on or reshared them. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Feed.

patches_added.name: Phone layout on big screens
patches_added.description: On a foldable or tablet, Instagram keeps its phone layout across the whole screen, with the tab bar at the bottom instead of down the side. Restart Instagram to see the change. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Layout.

patches_added.name: Preview chats
patches_added.description: Long press a chat in your messages and tap Preview to read its newest messages without opening it, so nobody sees Seen. You can reply from there too. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Messages.

patches_modified.name: Carousel arrows
patches_modified.description: Puts a back and a next arrow on a post's carousel in Home and Following, so a tap moves to the next photo or video without a swipe, and can move its page dots onto a round pill over the photo. The pill can be solid, see-through or frosted glass. Both start off. Turn them on in HushGram settings > Feed.
patches_modified.previous_description: Puts a back and a next arrow on a post's carousel in Home and Following, so a tap moves to the next photo or video without a swipe, and can move its page dots onto a round pill over the photo. Both start off. Turn them on in HushGram settings > Feed.

patches_modified.name: Seek bar on feed videos
patches_modified.description: Shows a bar along the bottom of the video playing in your feed that you can drag to jump to any point in it. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Feed. Another switch there adds a small button on the video that shows or hides the bar, and a choice under it makes the bar see-through or puts it on frosted glass.
patches_modified.previous_description: Shows a bar along the bottom of the video playing in your feed that you can drag to jump to any point in it. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Feed. Another switch there adds a small button on the video that shows or hides the bar.

patches_modified.name: Seek bar on stories
patches_modified.description: Shows a bar near the bottom of a video story that you can drag to jump to any point in the video. Photos don't get one. A choice under it makes the bar see-through or puts it on frosted glass. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Stories.
patches_modified.previous_description: Shows a bar near the bottom of a video story that you can drag to jump to any point in the video. Photos don't get one. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Stories.

patches_modified.name: Clean up Reels
patches_modified.description: Hides extra buttons and prompts on reels, such as Follow, Edits, templates, Meta AI, Ray-Ban Meta glasses, friends' activity, the Add a comment bar, the reply bar on reels from chats, the Save button, the Create and Your algorithm buttons, the Friends tab and the Reels tab's top bar. Each one has its own switch, and Burn-in guard can dim a reel's buttons, and a story's, while you aren't touching the screen. Keep clear mode on carries Instagram's clear mode to the next reels, and can start every reel in it. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Reels.

Each one has its own switch, and Burn-in guard can dim a reel's buttons while you aren't touching the screen. Keep clear mode on carries Instagram's clear mode to the next reels, and can start every reel in it. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Reels.

patches_modified.name: Download any reel
patches_modified.description: Adds Download to the menu of every reel and saves it without Instagram's watermark. You choose the quality, and best is the default. A separate Download cover switch also saves the reel's cover picture, the largest one the post carries, and Download audio saves just its sound. Download as video on a carousel with music saves every page, in order. A separate switch under Downloads puts a download icon under Save beside each reel, and others add a Lens icon for copying a reel's text, a speed icon and a Full screen icon. On by default. Turn it off in HushGram settings > Reels.

patches_modified.name: Full screen Reels and Home
patches_modified.description: Hides the status bar and the navigation bar while Reels shows, and optionally while Home or your messages do. Swipe in from the edge to bring them back for a moment. Back and the keyboard work as usual. It can also show stories over the whole screen on tall phones. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Reels (Full screen Reels), Feed (Full screen Home), Messages (Full screen Messages) and Stories (Stories fill the screen).

patches_modified.name: Premium
patches_modified.description: Unlocks premium

patches_modified.name: AMOLED dark theme
patches_modified.description: Makes TikTok's dark mode backgrounds pure black, or a dark color you pick in this patch's options. Black lets OLED screens switch those pixels off. Light mode doesn't change. It's built in while patching, so only patching again without it undoes it.

patches_modified.name: Accent color
patches_modified.description: Swaps the red of TikTok's main buttons and red text for blue, green, purple, orange, teal or a color code you type in this patch's options, or for the color of the phone's wallpaper theme on Android 12 and up. Warnings stay red, and so can icons with the red drawn in. It's built in while patching, so only patching again without it undoes it.

patches_modified.name: Advanced downloads
patches_modified.description: Adds more ways to save: pick the video quality, save full-size photos, the sound on its own or a photo post as one video, hold a profile picture or story to save it, save a story or a video's cover from the share sheet, and pick videos on a profile grid to save in one run. Video quality starts at Highest, keeping the existing default. Configure these controls in the patch settings > Downloads.

patches_modified.name: Allow Duet and Stitch
patches_modified.description: Shows the Duet and Stitch buttons on videos whose creator turned them off, so you can still make one. TikTok may still refuse some videos or the upload. Starts off. Turn it on in the patch settings > Share sheet.

patches_modified.name: Allow screenshots and Circle to Search
patches_modified.description: Lets screenshots, screen recordings and Circle to Search work on TikTok screens that would otherwise come out black. Starts off. Turn it on in the patch settings > App behavior, then restart TikTok.

patches_modified.name: Always show publish date
patches_modified.description: Shows the date a video was posted next to the creator's name, so you can tell how old it is. It can also show the exact time, or dates on profile grids. On by default. Turn it off in the patch settings > Interface.

patches_modified.name: Always upload in HD
patches_modified.description: Posts every video you upload in HD, as if you'd turned on TikTok's own HD upload setting each time. Videos TikTok doesn't count as high quality post as usual. Starts off. Turn it on in the patch settings > App behavior.

patches_modified.name: App lock
patches_modified.description: Asks for your fingerprint, face or PIN before TikTok opens, and again when you come back after a time you pick, so nobody else can open it on your phone. Starts off. Turn it on in the patch settings > App behavior.

patches_modified.name: Automatic video advance
patches_modified.description: Moves on to the next video by itself when one ends, so you can watch hands-free. It can also turn on TikTok's auto scroll in search results. Starts off. Turn it on in the patch settings > App behavior.

patches_modified.name: Block P2P video relay
patches_modified.description: Removes the files TikTok uses to pass videos on to other viewers through your phone's internet connection. The app gets about 3.5 MB smaller. It's built in while patching, so only patching again without it brings them back.

patches_modified.name: Block author button
patches_modified.description: Adds buttons on videos to block the creator, hide them only on your phone, or block the sound, so you can get rid of what you don't want in one tap. Starts off. Turn it on in the patch settings > Interface.

patches_modified.name: Block contact list access
patches_modified.description: Gives TikTok an empty contact list when it tries to read your phone's contacts, so it can't use them to suggest friends. Starts off. Turn it on in the patch settings > App behavior.

patches_modified.name: Block installed app scanning
patches_modified.description: Gives TikTok an empty list when it asks which apps are on your phone, so it learns less about you. Opening another app from TikTok still works. Starts off. Turn it on in the patch settings > App behavior.

patches_modified.name: Block popups
patches_modified.description: Lets you stop TikTok's popups, like friend suggestions and offers. Each one joins a checklist after it first appears, and once ticked it won't come back. Sign-in, age and verification screens are never blocked. Starts off. Turn it on in the patch settings > Interface.

patches_modified.name: Block suggested video notifications
patches_modified.description: Stops TikTok's "Videos you might like" notifications about popular videos it picked for you. Messages, comments, likes and posts from people you follow still come through. On by default. Turn it off in the patch settings > Interface.

patches_modified.name: Camera and microphone indicator
patches_modified.description: Shows a small mark in the top corner while TikTok is using the camera or microphone, so you always know when it is. Starts off. Turn it on in the patch settings > App behavior.

patches_modified.name: Change app name
patches_modified.description: Shows a name you choose under the app icon, so the patched TikTok is easy to tell apart from another copy. Type the name in this patch's options. Inside the app it still says TikTok.

patches_modified.name: Comment publish diagnostics
patches_modified.description: Adds a note to the diagnostic report about how far a comment got when it fails to post, which helps track down comments that vanish without an error. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_modified.name: Comment send fix
patches_modified.description: Fixes comments that TikTok sometimes drops without any message, so the comment you send actually posts. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_modified.name: Comment sort controls
patches_modified.description: Shows TikTok's full comment sort menu on every video, with hot, newest, media and creator options, even when your account only got a cut-down version. Starts off. Turn it on in the patch settings > Comments and translation.

patches_modified.name: Comment tools
patches_modified.description: Hides comments with words you pick or from accounts you pick, and adds a search box for a video's comments. It can also make links tappable and show poll results before you vote. Starts off. Turn it on in the patch settings > Comments and translation.

patches_modified.name: Confirm feed interactions
patches_modified.description: Asks for a second tap before Follow, a like, or a quick repost goes through, so a stray tap doesn't count. Starts off. Turn it on in the patch settings > Interface.

patches_modified.name: Copy bio and IDs
patches_modified.description: Lets you long-press a bio to copy it, and adds share sheet buttons that copy a username, user ID or video ID. On by default. Turn it off in the patch settings > App behavior.

patches_modified.name: Copy comments without username
patches_modified.description: When you copy a comment, you get just its text, without the username in front. On by default. Turn it off in the patch settings > Comments and translation.

patches_modified.name: Custom launcher icon
patches_modified.description: Gives TikTok's home screen icon a themed version that takes your wallpaper's color on Android 13 and up. The options can also make it black, plain or your own picture. Only patching again without it puts the old icon back.

patches_modified.name: Custom offline videos limit
patches_modified.description: Lets you pick how many videos TikTok saves for watching offline, from 1 to 10,000, and keep them until you delete them. Handy when you're often without internet. Starts off. Turn it on in the patch settings > Downloads.

patches_modified.name: Device privacy guard
patches_modified.description: Stops TikTok reading what you copied and gives it a blank advertising ID. Can also hide a VPN connection and root status with details about root tools, and give TikTok a new device identity. Each switch starts off in the patch settings > App behavior. Changing Hide root needs a restart.

patches_modified.name: Diagnostic tools
patches_modified.description: Adds logs and reports you can save or share when something goes wrong, so a problem is easier to report and fix. Starts off. Turn it on in the patch settings > Diagnostics.

patches_modified.name: Disable login requirement
patches_modified.description: Stops TikTok from forcing you to sign in before you can keep browsing. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_modified.name: Disable screen capture detection
patches_modified.description: Stops TikTok from noticing and reacting when you take a screenshot or record the screen. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_modified.name: Disable telemetry
patches_modified.description: Stops TikTok sending usage statistics and crash reports to TikTok and the tracking services it uses, so less of what you do in the app leaves your phone. Starts off. Turn it on in the patch settings > App behavior.

patches_modified.name: Disable the long press quick share
patches_modified.description: Stops a long press on Share from opening TikTok's quick share, so you don't send a video by accident. Starts off. Turn it on in the patch settings > Interface.

patches_modified.name: Disable the long press repost
patches_modified.description: Stops a long press on Like from opening TikTok's repost option, so you don't repost by accident. Starts off. Turn it on in the patch settings > Interface.

patches_modified.name: Double-tap controls
patches_modified.description: Lets a double tap on a video do nothing, open its comments, copy the link, save the sound or the frame on screen, speed the video up, or set a sleep timer instead of liking it, so you don't like videos by accident. Starts off. Pick an action in the patch settings > Interface.

patches_modified.name: Downloads
patches_modified.description: Saves videos and photos without TikTok's watermark, even when the creator turned downloads off. You can also choose the folders and file names. On by default. Turn it off in the patch settings > Downloads.

patches_modified.name: Drop the animated image cache
patches_modified.description: Lets you make TikTok decode animated stickers and GIFs one frame at a time as they play, instead of a few frames ahead, so they use a little less memory. Starts off. Turn it on in the patch settings > App behavior.

patches_modified.name: Enable voice comments
patches_modified.description: Lets you turn on TikTok's voice comments, so you can record and post a spoken comment, for accounts that don't have them yet. It hasn't been tried on a real account, so it may not work. Starts off. Turn it on in the patch settings > Comments and translation.

patches_modified.name: Expand activity list
patches_modified.description: Shows the whole Activity and New followers lists in the Inbox, so you don't have to tap View all. Starts off. Turn it on in the patch settings > Interface.

patches_modified.name: Feature Gate Lab
patches_modified.description: Adds an advanced page that lists the hidden settings TikTok uses to test features and lets you change them. It's for people who like to experiment. Starts off. Turn it on in the patch settings > Diagnostics.

patches_modified.name: Feature Gate Recorder
patches_modified.description: Records which hidden TikTok settings the app reads while you use it, and which ones changed. It's a research tool and changes nothing in TikTok. Start a recording in the patch settings > Diagnostics.

patches_modified.name: Feed filter
patches_modified.description: Hides ads in the feed, and lets you hide other things you don't want to see, like LIVEs, Shop posts, AI videos or videos with words, creators or sounds you pick. Hiding ads is on by default. Everything else starts off in the patch settings > Feed controls.

patches_modified.name: Feed tab navigation
patches_modified.description: Lets you hide feed and bottom tabs you don't use, rename the bottom tabs, choose the tab TikTok opens on and stop For You reloading when you tap Home. Starts off, except holding Home to open the patch settings. Find it in the patch settings > Feed navigation.

patches_modified.name: Feed text sizes
patches_modified.description: Lets you make video descriptions, creator names and post dates bigger or smaller, so they're easier to read. Starts off. Pick a size in the patch settings > Interface.

patches_modified.name: Fit the video to the screen
patches_modified.description: Shows the whole video instead of cutting off its sides on folding phones, squarer screens and split screen. A second switch does the opposite and fills the screen. Starts off. Turn it on in the patch settings > App behavior.

patches_modified.name: Fix Google login
patches_modified.description: Makes Sign in with Google work in the patched app, where it would otherwise fail. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_modified.name: Foldable split comment view
patches_modified.description: On a folding phone or tablet, shows comments beside the video instead of over it when the screen is wide enough. Starts off. Turn it on in the patch settings > App behavior.

patches_modified.name: Follow diagnostics
patches_modified.description: Tells you when TikTok quietly turned down a follow, and why, since the app shows it as if it worked. With diagnostic logging on, the details go in the report too. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_modified.name: Force show Auto scroll
patches_modified.description: Makes TikTok's Auto scroll action available without starting it automatically. Control it in the patch settings > App behavior.

patches_modified.name: Ghost mode
patches_modified.description: Stops TikTok telling people you viewed their story or profile, or that you're typing. What TikTok already recorded stays. A separate switch hides your online status. Starts off. Turn it on in the patch settings > App behavior.

patches_modified.name: Hide CAPTCHA popups
patches_modified.description: Skips the puzzle TikTok shows while you're just browsing. A puzzle right after you like, follow, comment or repost still shows, and so do sign-in, SMS and two-step checks. Starts off. Turn it on in the patch settings > Interface, then restart TikTok.

patches_modified.name: Hide Play Store update offer
patches_modified.description: Stops the Play Store offering to swap the patched TikTok for the store version. The catch: a build with a lower version number won't install over it, and uninstalling to go back can erase TikTok's data on your phone.

patches_modified.name: Hide already seen videos
patches_modified.description: Remembers the videos you've watched and hides them when the feed sends them again, so you only see new ones. The list stays on your phone. Starts off. Turn it on in the patch settings > Feed controls.

patches_modified.name: Hide comment popup ads
patches_modified.description: Stops the brand animation that pops up over the comments when someone types a word or emoji an advertiser paid for. Starts off. Turn it on in the patch settings > Comments and translation.

patches_modified.name: Hide comment typing suggestions
patches_modified.description: Hides the emoji and sticker suggestions that pop up above the comment box while you type. The emoji and sticker buttons still work. Starts off. Turn it on in the patch settings > Comments and translation.

patches_modified.name: Hide feed LIVE button
patches_modified.description: Removes the LIVE button and the side menu button from the top left of the feed, for a cleaner screen. Each has its own switch, and both start off. Turn them on in the patch settings > Interface.

patches_modified.name: Hide feed follow button
patches_modified.description: Removes the + follow button under creators' pictures on the feed, so you don't follow someone by accident. Starts off. Turn it on in the patch settings > Interface.

patches_modified.name: Hide feed save button
patches_modified.description: Removes the save button from the right side of the feed, for a cleaner screen. Starts off. Turn it on in the patch settings > Interface.

patches_modified.name: Hide feed search button
patches_modified.description: Removes the search button from the top right of the feed, for a cleaner screen. Starts off. Turn it on in the patch settings > Interface.

patches_modified.name: Hide floating promotions
patches_modified.description: Hides the floating promotion badges, coins and timers on the feed, and can hide the rewards button on your profile. Starts off. Turn it on in the patch settings > Interface, and App behavior for the rewards button.

patches_modified.name: Hide inbox items
patches_modified.description: Lets you hide Inbox rows you don't use, like message requests, TikTok Shop and the stories row, plus call buttons and suggested replies in chats. Each has its own switch. Also offers search in loaded Activity notifications. Starts off. Turn it on in the patch settings > Interface.

patches_modified.name: Hide inbox stories
patches_modified.description: Hides the row of stories at the top of the Inbox. It uses the same switch as Hide inbox items. Starts off. Turn it on in the patch settings > Interface.

patches_modified.name: Hide profile shortcuts
patches_modified.description: Hides the shortcuts you pick from the row under a profile's bio, like TikTok Studio or Your orders, and can hide the Thoughts bubble. Starts off. Turn it on in the patch settings > App behavior, then restart TikTok.

patches_modified.name: Hide search suggestions
patches_modified.description: Hides the searches TikTok suggests before you type, and can hide the search rewards banner. Your own search history stays. Starts off. Turn it on in the patch settings > App behavior.

patches_modified.name: Hide suggested accounts
patches_modified.description: Hides TikTok's People you may like suggestions in the Inbox, on profiles, on the Friends tab and in the feed. It uses the same switch as Hide inbox items. Starts on, keeping the existing default. Control it in the patch settings > Interface.

patches_modified.name: Hide the launcher shortcuts
patches_modified.description: Empties the menu that pops up when you press and hold TikTok's icon on your home screen. Tapping the icon still opens the app. Starts off. Turn it on in the patch settings > App behavior.

patches_modified.name: Hide the risk control CAPTCHA
patches_modified.description: Lets Hide CAPTCHA popups also skip the puzzle TikTok's account safety check raises while you're just browsing. SMS and two-step checks always show. It sits on TikTok's account checks, which is why it isn't picked for you.

patches_modified.name: Hide video overlays
